title: WaSPPipe and wf-amplicon Pipeline Wrapper
description: Runs the WaSPPipe basecalling, demultiplexing, and downstream analysis pipeline.

workspace_dir.title: Workspace Directory
workspace_dir.description: Absolute path to the epi2me_wasapp workspace directory on your machine.
workspace_dir.help_text: Select the absolute path to the epi2me_wasapp folder. E.g. Y:/Jonathan/Ian_lab_work/epi2me_wasapp

pod5_dir.title: POD5 Input Directory
pod5_dir.description: Path to the folder containing input POD5 files.
pod5_dir.help_text: Select the folder containing pod5 files. E.g. Y:/Jonathan/Ian_lab_work/wasPP_workflow_v2/input/pod5

dorado_model_path.title: Dorado Model Path
dorado_model_path.description: Path to the Dorado basecalling model directory.
dorado_model_path.help_text: Select the directory of the dorado basecalling model. E.g. Y:/Jonathan/Ian_lab_work/wasPP_workflow_v2/input/packages/dorado-1.4.0-linux-x64/models/dna_r10.4.1_e8.2_400bps_sup@v5.2.0

primer_files_dir.title: Primer Files Directory
primer_files_dir.description: Path to the folder containing primer fasta and mastersheet files.
primer_files_dir.help_text: Select the folder containing linked primer and reference fasta files. E.g. Y:/Jonathan/Ian_lab_work/wasPP_workflow_v2/input/primer_files

outdir.title: Output Directory
outdir.description: Directory for output of all workflow results.

run_name.title: Run Name
run_name.description: Name of the sequencing run used for naming outputs.

kit_name.title: Kit Name
kit_name.description: Ligation/Barcoding kit name for dorado basecalling and demuxing.

min_qscore.title: Min Q-Score
min_qscore.description: Minimum Q-score filtering threshold for basecalling.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Number of threads to allocate for wf-amplicon.

notebooklm_exec.title: NotebookLM Executable
notebooklm_exec.description: Command or path to run notebooklm in the system.
